name: Kkumkkunikka Romance-in Geojanh-a
source: After a terrible breakup with her boyfriend, Jaime finds a white phone amongst his belongings. Jaime ends up connecting to her dream through the strange app on the phone named 'Dream Connector' where she ends up meeting a mysterious man...
translation: 与男友经历了一场糟糕的分手后，杰米在他的物品中发现了一部白色手机。通过手机里名为“梦境连接器”的奇怪应用，杰米进入了自己的梦境，并在那里遇见了一位神秘男子……
